item.title: A Malaysian BBQ Dinner at Songbird Parlour — Thu Jul 23, 5:00 PM — Songbird Parlour
item.description:
Join Songbird Parlour for a Malaysian BBQ Dinner with Jessy Manuel, a special four-course collaborative dinner preview inspired by Southeast Asian and Pacific Island flavors, fire cooking, and family traditions. Created by chef Jessy Manuel, the evening explores smoke, citrus, spice, and sweetness through dishes rooted in heritage and memory. Guests will enjoy a menu featuring banana blossom salad, shrimp with kaffir lime and Thai basil, BBQ chicken with coconut garlic rice, and marinated cherries and plums. This intimate one-night event serves as the first chapter of a new in-home restaurant concept inspired by gathering people together through meaningful food and storytelling. Reservations are strongly recommended.

item.title: A Conversation Between Arthur Drooker and Richard Neill — Sat Jul 25, 12:30 PM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Please join us for a conversation between Photographer Arthur Drooker and Curator Richard Neill about the inspiration for Arthur's photographic project, “Thirty-Six Views of the Golden Gate Bridge.” The conversation between Drooker and Neill includes the process of creating the exhibit and book and the historical research that went into making the photographs. This will be followed by an audience Q&A. Books will be available for signing at the event. Richard Neill is a Photographer, Filmmaker and Curator and a member of the PAC Exhibitions Committee.
Please note that photography and video recording may take place during this event. By participating, you grant the Petaluma Arts Center permission to use your image for storytelling, marketing, and/or documentation purposes. By registering for this event, you also agree to receive occasional email communications from Petaluma Arts Center. You may unsubscribe at any time. Please reach out to info@petalumaartscenter.org with any ques

item.title: 150th Fig Tree Party at Quivira Vineyards — Sat Jul 25, 5:00 PM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Guests are invited to a once-in-a-generation celebration honoring the 150th birthday of Quivira's historic fig tree. The evening begins with a 5:00 PM reception featuring Hog Island Oyster Company, followed by a seated, multi-course dinner highlighting seasonal cuisine paired with Quivira wines. Desserts from Cousteaux's will be served alongside live music, creating a festive atmosphere under the stars. Throughout the evening, guests will gather to toast the iconic fig tree and reflect on its legacy and the land, community, and history it represents. Seating is limited, and early reservations are encouraged for this memorable celebration.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Sandy's — Sat Jul 25, 7:00 PM — Little Saint
item.description:
Sandy’s emerged from the ashes of The Botticellis, the critically acclaimed and influential Bay Area band led by singer, songwriter, and composer Alexi Glickman, which released two EPs and one LP before disbanding. In the wake of that breakup, the band’s members scattered into a range of new projects: Glickman produced and drummed for Little Wings, Zack Ehrlich and Ryan Browne joined Sonny Smith to form Sonny and the Sunsets, and Sandy’s began as a casual recording and performing outlet for Glic
Source: Little Saint

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Jul 26, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Family Search Center — Tue Jul 28, 1:00 PM — The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
item.description: Discover your family story at our Family Search Center You will find our center in the Lakeport building in the room next to the nursery. Local volunteers can help jumpstart your family history journey. Our center is staffed on Tuesdays from 1pm - 4pm, reach us in person or by phone \(707\) 280-9545 during those hours. All services provided in centers are free. You’ll enjoy: Personalized help Center guests can receive personal help from volunteers in one of more than 5,400 centers worldwide. Access to technology Centers offer complimentary access to computers, internet, and subscription family history websites. Available resources vary by location. Access to exclusive records Visitors to FamilySearch Centers get special access to images of historical records that are only available in centers. Websites available at all locations: Ancestry, My Heritage, Family Search, Find My Past, American Ancestors, Geneanet https://www.family search.org Explore videos about family history and temples

item.title: Frank Lloyd Wright Civic Center Tours — Fri Jul 31, 10:30 AM — Civic Center
item.description:
Price: Adult $10, Senior/Full Time Student $5 \(Plus a $2 p er ticket service Charge Online\)
Ticket Info:
Sponsor: Marin Center
Link: http://www.marincounty.org/depts/cu
The Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Marin County Civic Center is a national- and state-designated historic landmark. Ninety minute docent-led tours of the Civic Center are offered every Wednesday and Friday at 10:30 am, leaving from the second floor Café, Room 233. The cost is $10 adults and $5 seniors and students. No reservations are required. Groups of ten or more can arrange a private docent tour by calling the Visitor Services Office at \(415\) 473-3762.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Gloria Ferrer Anniversary Celebration Dinner — Fri Jul 31, 6:00 PM — Gloria Ferrer Winery
item.description:
Celebrate a milestone evening at Gloria Ferrer with an elegant dinner marking the winery's 40th Anniversary and the start of a special weekend of festivities. Guests will enjoy a refined multi-course dining experience held in the winery's caves, thoughtfully paired with exceptional wines. The evening features rare library selections, curated wine pairings, and a special tasting of Gloria Ferrer's commemorative 40th Anniversary Cuvée. Set in an intimate and sophisticated atmosphere, this exclusive event offers a unique opportunity to savor outstanding wines while honoring four decades of winemaking excellence. Perfect for wine enthusiasts and food lovers alike, this memorable celebration showcases the craftsmanship, heritage, and hospitality that have defined Gloria Ferrer for 40 years.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Nature Hike Vallejo Swett Ranches — Sat Aug 1, 9:00 AM — Vallejo Swett Ranches
item.description:
Come explore the hills between Fairfield, Benicia, and Vallejo. Solano Land Trust docents will guide you through this area, known as the King-Swett Ranches. Docents will share insights about the birds and other wildlife that call this area home, and give you a great workout!
Hike level: Moderate to Moderately Strenuous Please note: Vallejo Swett is an undeveloped property with no formal trails. This is a rugged & an off trail hike. Participants could be climbing or going under fences, and tree branches. Docents also can go up & along of steep and clumpy ground mountain sides.
\*Please note, cancellation of the hike may occur due to County Fire Danger Warnings and closures of open spaces and parks. Once registered, you will receive any updates should this ever happen.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
